title: Pre-primary participation, SDG regions compared, by sex
headline: Northern Africa and Western Asia: pre-primary participation up 23.2 points since 2005
subtitle: The participation rate in organized learning (one year before the official primary entry age), by sex as defined as the percentage of children in the given age range who participate in one or more organized learning programme, including programmes which offer a combination of education and care.
